text:
Theo: quick break — Cleo (my chinchilla) discovered an oversized teacup and turned it into a private SPA. pic: cleo_teacup.jpg https://i.imgur.com/cleo_teacup.jpg :chinchilla: :tea:
Marta: omg the fluff radius is off the charts :heart_eyes: did you knit that tiny towel?
Theo: nope it's a handkerchief from the 90s. Cleo insisted on towel + cucumber (pretend cucumber)
Ish: request: video. i need cleansing vibes for my inbox
Theo: uploading clip `cleo_spa.mov` — https://i.imgur.com/cleo_spa.mov
Rita: oh my god that tiny sneeze at 0:06 :sob: :sparkles:
Marta: poll: should Cleo be in the official sticker pack? react :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:
Ish: +1 for sticker. also suggesting variants: "Cleo-in-cup", "Cleo-bonk", "Cleo-sleep"
sticker-bot: :chinchilla: sticker added
Theo: design idea: pastel teacup with tiny crown, emoji name `:cleo-cup:`?
Rita: i'm volunteer #1 for sketching; also calling dibs on first sticker order
Marta: follow-up: anyone else want to nominate their pet for "Tiny Spa" segment at town hall? quick one-liner + clip
Ish: submitting a 3s clip of my cat ignoring a cucumber (for context)
Theo: thanks friends — will DM design and send high-res photo. end of thread.
